title: Define and cover refused-relay bypass across a durability-held historical queue front
outcome: The direct-send contract explicitly decides whether a non-runnable historical front with an unacknowledged durability hold blocks an exact refused-relay bypass, and behavior matches that decision.
acceptance: Record a concrete contract decision for a non-runnable historical front carrying an unacknowledged durability hold, distinct from the selected runnable relay carrier's own hold.
A controlled behavioral test creates that queue/hold shape, verifies the decided direct-send result and unchanged retained entries, and still proves a held selected relay carrier blocks bypass.
